source: TRRUST v2 (grnpedia.org) — literature-curated human TF-target regulon
assay: manual curation from PubMed (sentence-level); sign = Activation/Repression/Unknown
caveat: curated TF->target (transcriptional). Small (9,396 edges) but PubMed-backed and signed. Measured here: condition-inference top-3 80% (vs reg 76%), but which-targets-move 1.1x (does NOT beat the wall) — like reg, a curated edge still may not fire in a given cell context.
